description.value: Bella Coola Mountain Lodge is a boutique-style lodge in Hagensborg, BC, set in the Great Bear Rainforest near Tweedsmuir Provincial Park. The property traces its roots to an 1895 cedar cabin that once sheltered travellers on the multi-day journey to Williams Lake, and is now operated by the Lansdowne family. Guided fjord, hot-springs, and wildlife tours are offered in partnership with Bella Coola Grizzly Tours.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a restaurant named 'Bella Coola Mountain Lodge Bistro,' but the website makes no mention of a bistro or any public-facing food service; the only food offering found is a continental breakfast explicitly described as available to lodge guests for an add-on fee. The website is clearly that of a boutique lodge/accommodation business, not a restaurant, so Food & Drink categorization is unsupported. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
